name: DXF Offset Tool
description: Grows every hole and shrinks the plate outline in a DXF by a set allowance (default 1/16"), putting hole geometry on its own layer. Pick a folder of DXFs; each is written back out as '<name> OFFSET.dxf' with everything else in the file untouched.
author: Anthony Sieben

fields.label: Hole diameter increase (inches)
fields.description: How much bigger each hole's DIAMETER gets. Default 0.0625 (1/16").

fields.label: Plate edge offset per side (inches)
fields.description: How far each edge of the outer profile moves inward. Default 0.0625 (1/16") - a 12x12 plate becomes 11.875x11.875.

fields.label: Layer name for holes
fields.description: Hole geometry is moved to this layer in the output DXF.

fields.label: Single DXF file (optional)
fields.description: If set, only this file is processed and the folder prompt is skipped.
